description: Call one command of a clify site and get JSON back. args holds the command's params (see clify_help). Lists return count, total and nextPage (args for the next page). Write commands return a dry-run preview unless confirm:true.

confirm.description: true sends a write; otherwise writes return a preview

fields.description: comma-separated keys to keep (dot paths ok); "*" for all

limit.description: first N items of a list

name: clify_run
title: Run a site command
